headline: Nigeria Launches 2026 Licensing Round Offering 40 Oil and Gas Blocks
summary: The Nigerian Upstream Petroleum Regulatory Commission urged prospective investors to participate in the 2026 Licensing Round, which features 40 oil and gas blocks.
why: Licensing rounds are critical for oil and gas companies seeking to expand exploration acreage and sustain long-term hydrocarbon production reserves.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: Offering new oil and gas blocks could attract capital investment into the country's energy sector.
